```artifact
GUI Event Graphs Test Suite for U03_Alarms

1. GUI Event Graph for LOW VTI Alarm Activation
   - Start at the VTI computation screen
   - Input VTI value > Threshold
   - Activate LOW VTI alarm
   - End at the alarm notification screen

2. GUI Event Graph for LOW VTI Alarm Threshold Setting
   - Start at the alarm settings screen
   - Input new threshold value X
   - Set LOW VTI alarm threshold to X
   - End at the alarm settings confirmation screen

3. GUI Event Graph for HIGH VTI Alarm Activation
   - Start at the VTI computation screen
   - Input VTI value > Threshold
   - Activate HIGH VTI alarm
   - End at the alarm notification screen

4. GUI Event Graph for HIGH VTI Alarm Threshold Setting
   - Start at the alarm settings screen
   - Input new threshold value Y
   - Set HIGH VTI alarm threshold to Y
   - End at the alarm settings confirmation screen

5. GUI Event Graph for VTI Computation for Each Breath
   - Start at the VTI computation screen
   - Compute VTI for current breath
   - End at the VTI computation result screen

```
